doc.title: Article Time Epic Breakdown — Story 2.7 Cookie-Banner UI
doc.snippet: Seven verbatim ACs, 0.5-day effort, Prerequisite Story 2.5, GitHub Issue #94. Source: restoration of `blog-old/themes/article/layouts/partials/cookie-banner.html`. FR-048 extension (Privacy Policy Publication).

doc.title: PRD — Functional Requirements
doc.snippet: FR-047 Zero Tracking Cookies — informs banner-copy honesty (no-cookies claim). FR-048 Privacy Policy Publication — extended into runtime UI by this story. FR-049 Anonymous Analytics — informs banner-copy "Umami" mention.

doc.title: Architecture — JavaScript & SCSS
doc.snippet: JS module pattern lists `gdpr.js` as one of 7 jQuery-based modules with state via localStorage (this story uses sessionStorage for per-session scoping). SCSS structure is ITCSS-inspired: `assets/scss/elements/` is the documented home for component styles.

doc.title: Digital Garden Integration Architecture — Critical Agent Rules & Client-Side
doc.section: Critical Agent Rules (lines 762–771) and Client-Side Considerations (lines 1056–1062)
doc.snippet: Rule #5: "NEVER use jQuery (use vanilla JavaScript for all new features)" — drives AC #4 reconciliation. Client-Side: "No cookies for analytics: Umami uses cookieless tracking (GDPR-compliant)" — informs banner copy.

doc.title: Feature-Gap blog-old → blog (NEU)
doc.snippet: Documented gap closed by this story: "gdpr.js wurde ins neue Repo übernommen, Aber: Banner-Partial fehlt." Tracking via Issue #94. Legacy reference: `blog-old/themes/article/layouts/partials/cookie-banner.html`.

doc.title: Story 2.1 — Umami Analytics Integration
doc.snippet: Umami configured in cookieless mode — informs this story's banner copy ("cookielose Reichweitenmessung") and the no-consent-gate framing.

doc.title: Story 2.2 — Heart Button Component
doc.snippet: Sibling story established the localStorage-flag pattern for the heart-clicked state. This story uses sessionStorage instead (per-tab-session scope for "dismiss this notice for the session" semantics) — different scope, same family of pattern.

doc.title: Story 2.5 — Privacy Policy Page
doc.snippet: Story 2.5 pinned the privacy page to existing German slug `/pages/datenschutz/` (not `/pages/privacy/`). This story uses that URL as the AC #3 link target. Story 2.5 also retains `robotsdisallow: true` on `datenschutz.md` (extended by this story to also gate the cookie banner).

AC #5 — add `@use "elements/cookie-banner";` after `@use "elements/tooltip";` (line 44) to wire the new SCSS module into the build. Sibling order: badge, box, button, pagination, ribbon, search, tooltip → cookie-banner.

artifact.reason: AC #5 SCSS variable resolution — `@use "../vars/helpers";` exposes color tokens via `helpers.$dark`, `helpers.$gold`, `helpers.$gold-light`, `helpers.$light`, etc. Read this and `_colors.scss` before authoring `cookie-banner.scss` to use the actual variable names. `@mixin mobile` (line 195) is the `<= 640px` breakpoint helper.

AC #5 — actual theme variable names: `$dark` (hsl 190 11% 11%), `$gold` (hsl 35 45% 50%), `$gold-light` (hsl 29 100% 80%), `$light` (hsl 190 20% 90%). The story's suggested SCSS uses `$text` — use `$light` instead (no `$text` exists in this project). Also: `helpers.$dark` is darker primary surface; main background uses `color.adjust(helpers.$dark, $lightness: -2%)`.

Reference for remixicon SVG-symbol usage with `.Site.Params.remixicon_version` cache-busting query param. Same pattern the new cookie-banner partial should use for the close-line glyph: `<use xlink:href="{{ "fonts/remixicon/remixicon.symbol.svg" | relURL }}?t={{ .Site.Params.remixicon_version }}#close-line"></use>`.

CSP allowlist verification — `scriptsrc: ["'self'", "https://cloud.umami.is"]` already covers the new banner JS (concatenated into `js/bundle.js` and self-served). NO CSP changes needed for this story. `remixicon_version: 1750019714996` (line 1) is the cache-buster for the close-line glyph.

Legacy structural inspiration only — DO NOT restore the 3-button consent flow. This story scopes to a 1-button dismissible notice (privacy posture is "no cookies, no consent needed" — see Privacy Posture section in story Dev Notes).
Borrow the bottom-fixed positioning idea only. Do not restore the 3-button-flow-specific styling.

node.note: No new npm dependencies introduced by this story. Banner code is plain vanilla JS appended to the existing concat-bundled `assets/js/gdpr.js`. SCSS module compiles via Hugo Pipes / Dart Sass already configured.

hugo.note: Hugo (pinned `0.152.2` in GitHub Actions per Critical Agent Rule #7) — Pipes for SCSS/Dart Sass, JS concat/minify/fingerprint. No version bump needed.

project-conventions.icons: Remix Icon `-line` style preferred (Critical Agent Rule N/A but documented at digital-garden-integration-architecture.md line 759). `close-line` glyph for the banner close button. Cache-bust via `.Site.Params.remixicon_version`.
project-conventions.css-architecture: SCSS ITCSS-inspired: `vars/`, `src/bulma/`, `base/`, `elements/` (this story's home), `layout/`. New module wired via `@use "elements/cookie-banner";` in `assets/scss/main.scss` Elements block.
project-conventions.js-architecture: Vanilla JS for all new code (Critical Agent Rule #5 — `digital-garden-integration-architecture.md` line 768). gdpr.js head-bundled with jquery.js (`slice $jQuery $gdpr | resources.Concat`). Footer-bundled scripts: suncalc, main, search, firework, navbar, header.
project-conventions.storage: sessionStorage (per-tab-session) for the dismissal flag — contrast with Story 2.2's localStorage (per-device-persistent). Pattern precedent: localStorage = persistent UI state, sessionStorage = per-session dismissal.

constraints.constraint: NEVER use jQuery — use vanilla JavaScript for all new features. Source: `docs/2-solutioning/digital-garden-integration-architecture.md` line 768. Applies to AC #4: the new banner IIFE in `gdpr.js` is vanilla; the legacy jQuery `$(document).ready` visited-articles handler (lines 114–149) is grandfathered out of scope.

Pin Hugo version to 0.152.2 in GitHub Actions. Source: `digital-garden-integration-architecture.md` line 770. Not modified by this story (no GitHub Actions changes), but reaffirmed for any incidental rebuild test.

Dismissal state MUST be stored in `sessionStorage` (key: `cookie-banner-dismissed`, value: `'1'`), NOT cookies and NOT localStorage. AC #2 literal "NO cookies" + per-session scope semantics. Wrap reads/writes in try/catch — sessionStorage unavailable is acceptable degraded state (banner shows every page-load).

Use `role="dialog"` per AC #6 verbatim, paired with `aria-modal="false"` (non-blocking). Add `aria-labelledby="cookie-banner-title"`, `aria-describedby="cookie-banner-text"`, and `aria-live="polite"` (belt-and-braces SR announcement). Close button `aria-label="Hinweis schließen"` (German).
All UI strings in German with informal `Du`-form. Matches Stories 2.2 / 2.4 / 2.5 convention and the rest of `datenschutz.md` / `impressum.md` site copy.
Privacy policy link target is `/pages/datenschutz/` (NOT `/pages/privacy/`). Reconciliation: Story 2.5 pinned this German slug to match the existing footer-menu wiring. Verify at implementation time.

Banner is server-side suppressed via `{{- if not .Params.robotsdisallow }}…{{- end }}` gate in `baseof.html`. Pages with `robotsdisallow: true` (datenschutz, impressum) skip the partial entirely. Independent and complementary to the `@media print` CSS rule.
Banner uses `z-index: 100` to stay BELOW the back-to-top button (`z-index: 999999` per `assets/scss/main.scss` line 199). Sets a precedent: 100 = "above content, below page-chrome" overlays.

Wrapper has `hidden` attribute by default — banner only becomes visible after JS removes `hidden` and adds `is-visible`. Prevents flash-of-banner before JS decides whether to show it. Same pattern Story 2.4 webmention component uses.

Slide-up entry transition is 300ms ease-out (`translateY(100%) → translateY(0)` on `.is-visible`); mirror slide-down on `.is-dismissing`. `setTimeout(removeNode, 300)` matches the transition duration. `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { transition: none; }` disables the animation for users with the OS-level preference.

No CSP changes needed — banner code runs from the self-hosted bundle (`scriptsrc: ["'self'", "https://cloud.umami.is"]` already permits this). No inline scripts, no inline event handlers, no new external hosts. Source: `config/_default/params.yaml` lines 17–29.

No automated tests added in this story. Test infrastructure (`tests/build/`, `tests/e2e/`) bootstrapped by Story 1.1 (status: ready-for-dev at this story's drafting time, not landed). If 1.1 lands first, an OPTIONAL Playwright spec MAY be added — skip if test infra absent. Manual QA matrix (9 scenarios) in story Tasks section is sufficient for the 0.5-day estimate.

Bundle.js + style.css fingerprint hashes will change (new code → new hashes); this is normal fingerprint refresh, not a regression. All other body content, sitemap, RSS feeds, footer menu must remain byte-equivalent. Diff `public/index.html`, `public/articles/<sample>/index.html`, `public/pages/datenschutz/index.html`, `public/pages/impressum/index.html` to verify.

Two new files (`layouts/_partials/_base/cookie-banner.html`, `assets/scss/elements/cookie-banner.scss`); four modified files (`layouts/baseof.html` partial inclusion + gate; `layouts/_partials/_base/head.html` TODO comment removal; `assets/js/gdpr.js` vanilla IIFE; `assets/scss/main.scss` `@use` line). No changes to `config/`, `content/`, GitHub Actions, npm, or Secrets.

ideas.idea: Hugo build verification: `hugo --quiet && grep '<div id="cookie-banner"' public/index.html` should return 1+ match (home renders banner). `grep '<div id="cookie-banner"' public/pages/datenschutz/index.html` should return 0 matches (robotsdisallow gate).

Manual QA: open incognito, observe slide-up; click close, observe slide-down + DOM removal; reload same tab → no banner; close tab + reopen incognito → banner reappears (sessionStorage cleared with session). Inspect `Application → Storage → Session Storage` in DevTools to confirm `cookie-banner-dismissed: 1` is set.

Storage-degradation: Open in private window with sessionStorage disabled / quota-exceeded simulation. Banner shows on every page-load (acceptable degraded state). Verify no JS errors thrown (try/catch swallows them).

Visual + content check: confirm banner mentions "Umami", "cookielose", "Tracking-Cookies", links to `/pages/datenschutz/` (click the link, lands on the privacy policy). Confirm informal `Du`-form ("Deine Rechte findest Du").

Bundle smoke-test: `hugo --quiet --environment production --minify && grep -c "cookie-banner-dismissed" public/js/bundle.*.js` should return 1+ (the dismissal-flag string survives minification). No `$(...)` jQuery calls in the new IIFE block — `git diff assets/js/gdpr.js | grep -E '^\\+.*\\$\\('` should return 0 lines.

Visual: at 1200px wide, banner is centered, max-width 960px, dark translucent surface, gold-bordered close button. Inspect: `position: fixed`, `bottom: 0`, `z-index: 100`. At 375px wide, banner stacks vertically.

Keyboard: Tab from page top until close button focuses (visible focus ring). Enter dismisses. Reload, press Escape → dismisses immediately. Screen reader (NVDA on Windows): on first paint, SR announces title + body once via aria-live="polite".
Reduced-motion: Chrome DevTools → Rendering → Emulate CSS media feature `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Reload. Banner appears without slide animation (hard show).
Server-side suppression: visit `/pages/datenschutz/` in fresh incognito → no banner visible AND no `cookie-banner` in page source. Visit `/pages/impressum/` → same.
Print suppression: open home page → Ctrl+P → preview shows no banner. Verify CSS rule: `grep "@media print" public/style.*.css` includes `#cookie-banner { display: none !important; }`.

Build regression: capture pre-change `public/index.html` and `public/pages/datenschutz/index.html`. Apply story edits. Rebuild. Diff. Expected differences only: new `<div id="cookie-banner" hidden …>` block on home (not on datenschutz); changed `style.<hash>.css` and `js/bundle.<hash>.js` filenames. Sitemap and RSS unchanged.
Critical Agent Rule #5 verification: `git diff assets/js/gdpr.js` shows no new `$(...)` patterns in the new IIFE. Legacy jQuery handler at lines 114–149 is unchanged.
